div.p: 80+ master's degrees and 40+ doctoral programs. Fully funded research positions, industry fellowships, and access to $400M in annual research funding — designed for scholars who want to push the boundaries of knowledge.

div.p: Browse faculty research profiles and reach out to a potential supervisor whose work aligns with your interests before applying. Acceptance is highly dependent on supervisor availability.
Complete the Graduate Application at apply.Axion.edu/graduate. Choose up to two programs and specify full-time or part-time enrollment.
Transcripts, test scores, letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, and writing samples must be submitted before the deadline.
Shortlisted PhD applicants are invited to a virtual or on-campus interview with the admissions committee and prospective supervisor.
Accepted students receive an admission letter along with a detailed funding package (stipend, tuition waiver, benefits) within 4 weeks of the interview.
